capabilities: Show progress bars below notes in the File Explorer
Review and sort note progress in a dedicated sidebar
Set manual progress percentages via context menu or Properties
Configure per-folder targets, palettes, and scope rules
Filter tracked notes by path patterns
disambiguation: Not a task manager; progress comes from note length or a manually set percentage, not from checkboxes or to-dos.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Documentation is otherwise complete with a settings reference, filter patterns, and a troubleshooting section.
problem: In large vaults it is hard to see which notes are unfinished, barely started, or overgrown without opening each one, and length-based state is not visible in file lists.

relations.evidence: BRAT can install beta or pre-release versions directly from GitHub.

summary: Adds slim color-coded progress bars to the File Explorer and a sortable sidebar showing how complete each note is relative to a target character count.
